lines.en: Green flecks mark my hide.
Green like the leaves in the woods.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有一点青。
lines.en: A green tint follows my steps.
I walk steadily, as if counting steps.
Patches on me keep flashing.
I head toward the village.
Green specks drop from my feet.
I circle that stand of trees.
Each step leaves a little shine.
My hide is half see-through.
I stopped and looked at the stone.
The green slowly grows on me.
I tremble a little as I walk.
I follow the village road.
It's darker behind that tree.
I swell as I go.
I stand like a green stone.
This green stands out.
I wait for the village lamps to go out.
This ground suits emerald.
I don't eat. I draw from stone.
I shudder and shed green flecks.
I shelter from the light under the tree.
My surface is slick.
I'm counting how many steps left.
The stone here is pale.
I flicker in and out.

lines.zh: 我听见有人走过来的声音。
lines.en: I hear someone walking this way.
I'm counting the stone layers under me.
I'm deciding which patch is better.
The mountain wind smells of coins.

lines.zh: 我身上有一块颜色很深。
lines.en: There's one very dark patch on me.
Even your eyes look green.

lines.zh: 你身上有值钱的东西吧。
lines.en: You must be carrying something valuable.
This hide is greener than grass.
Stare too long and you'll want to mine me.
Keep that pick still.
I look at you to see where you stand.
Step back. This spot is mine.
The ground under you is green already.
Mine me? You can't.
I don't like the iron on you.
I'm estimating this patch's size.
Don't step in — this ground is turning green.
A green fleck came off.
One hit, and my green deepens.
My green dimmed briefly.
A bit of green on your hands.
I moved back, leaving a mark.
Each pang swells me a little more.
The light inside leaked out.
Another seam, shoulder to tail.
Only flecks came loose.
Only my color faded.
Something green? Let me see.

lines.zh: 你手里那点比豆子还小。
lines.en: That's smaller than a bean.
I don't eat. I need stone.
Back off — I can't hold it.
It's greener than I am.
Don't wave it in my eyes.

lines.zh: 这东西在村里能换不少。
lines.en: This would buy a lot in the village.
I won't trade. I have my own.
That shine on it looks false.
You're lowballing me.
Bring it closer; let me see it.
Green? It all looks the same to me.
Your hand shakes. You'll drop it.
Don't set it down. I'll cover it.
Its facets are too even.
Carrying that is like carrying money.
Bump me and you get green on you.
Ram me and you'll ache first.
Your hand's green after backing off.
Don't crowd. I'm swelling.
You knocked a small piece off.
My green hide is too slick to grip.
A few green flecks hit the ground.
A fleck lodged in your armor.
I'm knocked half an inch off balance.
Only one block between us.
My green isn't deep enough yet.
Two green ones together look alike.
You'll laugh at us.
One touch and chips litter the ground.
It's a little brighter than me.
The green on the ground joined up.
Neither of us has more afterwards.
This waits until the stone is grown.
The sound was light, like leaves.
Afterwards we're the same as before.
I pick up a green stone.
This color isn't deep enough.
Good color, but far too small.
Off the ground, its green fades.
A few grains fell to the ground.
I pressed it into my hide.
I'll keep this one.
Bending spills green all over.
This one fell right at my feet.
What I'm holding is a little cold.
You're standing on good stone.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，一片绿中的一点。
lines.en: I see you, a spot among green.
I'm heading toward you.

lines.zh: 我要把这地变成绿宝石。
lines.en: I'll turn this ground to emerald.
Small range, and you're close.
The green on me is deepening.
The ground under you is starting to shine.
This patch of green is mine.
This stone layer will do.
Retreating won't get you far.
Hunched low, I shuffle that way.
Leaves can't hide your green.
I follow the green flecks you leave.
The stone here is pale.
I move slowly, but never change course.
In the dark you're harder to see.
My green gives me away.
This one has to land on the seam.
You circled and came back.
I edge along the fence.
I burst and the stone turned green.
It's the stone I blast, not you.
Green flecks hit your face.
The green wave shoves you back.

lines.zh: 这一圈全变成绿宝石矿了。
lines.en: The ring turned to emerald ore.
My hide split and green light spilled.
A fleck lodged in your armor.
The grass is covered now.
Not much of me left.
The hole is shallow.
I seep out of the rock seam.

lines.zh: 这个地方的石头很值钱。
lines.en: The stone here is valuable.
I flashed green on landing.
A dot of green appeared on the wall.
I can see into the dark.
The stone on this level is soft.
I stood and a few grains fell.
I stayed here a while.
You've bought things in the village.
Someone has seen my green.
Fire muddied my green.
I broke into a small handful.
Water soaked in and the light stopped.

lines.zh: 两股气一起冲，石头都翻了。
lines.en: Both bursts went off and stone flipped.
The arrow cracked a whole piece.
That light washed my green away.
Hunger is fine; stone tastes sweeter.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我亮得像白天。
lines.en: The bolt struck and I lit like day.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石头可以改。
lines.en: There's no stone to change in the void.
